newsitem.title: Israel: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ISRAEL, Jan 7 - Haifa - Eight vessels due, 1-3 days delay expected. Loading/discharging at berth, 2 bulk, 4 containers, 3 tankers. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 1 bulk, 1 container vessel, 2 tankers. 3 Vessels under repair, 6 awaiting orders. Ashdod - Delays of 2-4 days. Loading/discharging at berth, 7 general cargo, 3 bulk, 4 containers, 2 tankers. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 5 general cargo, 6 bulk, 5 containers. Eilat - One vessel due, 1-2 days delay expected. Loading/discharging at berth, 1 container vessel, 1 passenger vessel. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 1 general cargo, 1 passenger vessel, 1 tanker.

MOZAMBIQUE, Jan 6 - Nacala - Port working normally (first come, first served basis). No restriction on berthing and sailing at night. Draft restriction 9.5 metres plus height of tide at general cargo berths, 14 metres at container berths. One tug available. Beira - General cargo berths working normally (first come, first served). Container/other terminals working normally. Pilotage possible 24 hours a day for vessels up to 140 metres loa with a maximum draft of 7.5 metres. Two tugs fully operational. Night navigation for larger vessels restricted and subject to prior arrangements with the port captain. Maputo - Pilotage now possible 24 hours a day for vessels up to 120 metres loa with a maximum draft of 9 metres. Two tugs available, one out of order. Night navigation for larger vessels restricted and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. All berths working normally and expected to remain so (first come, first served). Draft restriction in channel 9 metres less 0.5 metre plus rise of tide.
NAMIBIA, Jan 6 - Walvis Bay - Working normally.

SOUTH AFRICA, Jan 6 - Richards Bay - General cargo berths - vessels berthing on arrival and no major delays expected. Bulk import berths - No delays expected except for a minor delay on berth 701. Bulk export berths (minerals, etc.) - No delays up to 10/1, congestion expected from 10/1 p.m. to 13/1 p.m. At berth 703. Woodchip vessels can expect delays of up to 24 hours at berth 704. General - No major delays at coal terminal. 20 Vessels due by 13/1 and delays of between 24 and 48 hours can be expected. Bulk coal berths - 3 Vessels alongside, 16 due by 13/1. Berthing delays of 12-24 hours can be expected from 8/1.

Durban - Container terminal - Delays of up to 48 hours currently. Point New Pier/Maydon wharf berths - Working normally for general cargo vessels. Bunker supplies delays of 12 hours due to bunching of vessels. Drydock and floating dock - Fully booked for January and February. East London - General cargo/combi terminal berths - Busy but no delays expected. Drydock - Fully booked until end of January. Oil pipeline under-utilised. One wheat vessel in port. Tankers busy until end of January. Port Elizabeth - Five vessels in port. No delays expected on general or tanker berths. 1 Ore vessel in port. Container berths - 3 Vessels due by 7/1, 8 hours berthing delay for one vessel. Cape Town - Breakbulk berths/container terminal - Vessels berthing and operating on arrival. Vessels berthing and bunkering on arrival. Drydock and repair quay - Fully occupied, booking essential. Saldanha Bay - Working normally.

TUNISIA, Jan 4 - Tunis - One vessel awaiting instructions, 1 discharging marble blocks, 1 discharging wood, 1 other. Rades - One vessel discharging bananas, 1 loading containers, 2 ro/ro. Goulette - North side - 1 Passenger vessel, 1 cereal vessel, 1 motor tanker discharging soyabean. South side - 1 Vessel discharging grain, 1 loading clinker. 1 Vessel in roads awaiting instructions. Sfax - Five vessels operating of which 1 each discharging general cargo, bulk soyoil, bulk soymeal, 1 vessel loading bulk rock phosphate, 1 loading bulk olive pulp. Gabes - One vessel loading bulk fertiliser at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load of which 1 tanker with acid, 1 bulk fertiliser. Jan 7 - Bizerta - Four vessels in port of which 1 discharging white products, 1 discharging steel, 1 loading cement, 1 discharging coke. No delays or congestion. Zarzis - No vessels in port, no delays.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, Jan 6 - Dubai - Vessels operating in port from 29/12 to 4/1, 85 container vessels, 18 general cargo, 3 general cargo/container vessels, 1 bulk carrier, 5 car carriers, 17 tankers, 4 naval vessels, 2 UAE naval vessels, 1 livestock carrier, 4 bunkers/repairs/stores etc., 2 dhows, 8 barges, 6 tugs, 14 supply boats, 2 lpg tankers, 1 rig. Vessels due, 28 containers, 11 general cargo, 8 tankers. Loading at berth, 3 containers, 1 tanker. Discharging at berth, 4 general cargo, 1 tanker. Under repair/laid up - 2 General cargo, 8 tankers.

YEMEN, Jan 7 - Hodeidah - All berths are occupied, with the exception of Nos. 3 and 5. Five vessels alongside of which 2 bulk wheat, 2 sugar, 1 container vessel. 2 Wheat flour vessels waiting at anchorage. Berthing waiting time, general cargo up to 2 days, bagged cargo up to 4 days, bulk cargo up to 6 days, containers up to 1 day. Mokha - One vessel alongside idle after discharging wheat flour. No vessels anchored, no berthing waiting time.
